description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Aventis Solutions is recruiting Forward Deployed Software Engineers on behalf of partner technology firms; the actual hiring employers are not identified. The role involves partnering with customers to solve complex problems and building scalable software across areas including AI, government, financial services, healthcare, and critical infrastructure.
Forward Deployed Software Engineer building scalable software and solving customer technical problems

Responsibilities:
• Rather than just working behind the scenes, you'll become a trusted technical partner, helping customers solve meaningful problems while building scalable software that delivers measurable outcomes
• Every engagement is different, offering exposure to complex technical challenges, cutting-edge technologies, and some of the brightest engineering talent in the industry

Requirements:
• Experience working closely with customers or internal stakeholders to understand complex business challenges and deliver high-quality technical solutions
• Strong software engineering fundamentals with commercial experience across technologies such as TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, Java, JavaScript, or Golang
• Interest or experience working with modern AI tooling, large language models, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled software products
• Comfortable working across the full software development lifecycle, contributing to product decisions, rapid prototyping, and iterative customer delivery
• Ability to tackle technically challenging problems, adapt quickly to new environments, and deliver practical solutions under real world conditions
• Excellent interpersonal skills with the confidence to work directly alongside customers, senior stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams
• Passion for continuous learning, ownership, and building innovative software in fast-moving, high-performing environments

Preferred:
• Experience across cloud native architectures and distributed systems
• Exposure to GenAI frameworks and AI-powered applications is a significant advantage
